name: The Abu Dhabi EDITION
positioning: Marina-front EDITION hotel in downtown Abu Dhabi with Brett Weston photography in the guest rooms and a Mediterranean terrace restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base on the Al Bateen Marina waterfront
Guests who enjoy a steakhouse, a literary-themed cocktail bar and a spa with a hair salon

facts.text: The hotel is in the downtown district on the waterfront of Al Bateen Marina.
Guest room balconies take advantage of marina views and have outdoor furniture by Gandia Blasco.
Oak Room is a modern steakhouse.
Alba Terrace has an outdoor terrace with seating areas under pavilions or next to a reflection pool.
Market at EDITION is a healthy lifestyle restaurant with live cooking, open for all-day breakfast and lunch.
The EDITION Spa serves signature beverages, hand-blended tonics and light refreshments.
The spa includes an Italian designed Rossano Ferretti hair salon.
Chaps & Co. Barbershop offers a Little Chap Haircut for children aged under 12.
The hotel has two purpose-built gyms with premium cardio equipment by Life Fitness.
Pool day passes are available by contacting the hotel.

highlights.text: All guest rooms are adorned with photography by twentieth-century photographer Brett Weston.
The herringbone pattern of the guest room wood floors draws inspiration from local basket weaving techniques.
Alba Terrace has a large brass-clad aperitif bar and a Mediterranean theme.
Library Bar has artwork inspired by themes of language and the written word.
A secluded pool with marina skyline views offers cabana-side cocktails and light bites.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
Oak Room is a steakhouse focused on prime-grade cuts of meat.
